Material Design in XAML Toolkit 5.4.0
https://github.com/MaterialDesignInXAML/MaterialDesignInXamlToolkit/tree/v5.4.0
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/MaterialDesignThemes/5.4.0
Repository commit in the NuGet package: 14223ece627401f4e987fdd4ba2b1ac5674977ff

MaterialDesignThemes and MaterialDesignColors 5.4.0 are provided under the MIT
license in MaterialDesign-LICENSE.txt. The application uses the bundled light
theme and MaterialDesign3.Defaults.xaml, with the installed Microsoft YaHei UI
font for Chinese text. No Microsoft font is redistributed by this application.

Microsoft.Xaml.Behaviors.Wpf 1.1.142 is an indirect dependency, under the MIT
license in Microsoft.Xaml.Behaviors-LICENSE.txt.
https://github.com/microsoft/XamlBehaviorsWpf/tree/v1.1.142

The toolkit package also contains unmodified font files:
Roboto: Copyright 2011 Google Inc. All Rights Reserved.
Noto Sans: Copyright 2012 Google Inc. All Rights Reserved.
The inspected Roboto-Regular.ttf and NotoSans-Regular.ttf in the 5.4.0 NuGet
package identify Apache License 2.0 in their embedded font metadata. Its full
text is included in Fonts-Apache-2.0.txt. Roboto is a trademark of Google.
Noto is a trademark of Google Inc. Font names are retained for attribution.
The toolkit's tagged source additionally carries an OFL notice with the Noto
resources; it is preserved in Noto-OFL.txt. These notices accompany the package
even though the application selects an installed Chinese UI font.
https://github.com/MaterialDesignInXAML/MaterialDesignInXamlToolkit/tree/v5.4.0/src/MaterialDesignThemes.Wpf/Resources

This application does not modify the toolkit, colors, behaviors or font files.
The notices and licenses in this directory must accompany redistributed builds.
